descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S29 「已经有记录的病历上失败：Regenerate 失败后今天的记录还在，昨天的记录绝不当成今天的显示（两个模式）」 A failure on a chart that already has a note: today's note survives a failed Regenerate, and yesterday's note never shows as today's (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state（UAT OAT-03 step 4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94422 AC 5）
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up …（UAT OAT-03 step 3；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed)；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94422 AC 5；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android（UAT 3.3；UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given (a) Local stack; in each context a chart ({hospitalPatient}, {snfResident}) whose note N1 was generated today with the seam off. (b) A second Hospital patient ({hospitalPatient2}, Follow-up) and a second Nursing Home resident ({snfResident2}) with yesterday's note seeded (the previous note 3.6 keeps for 36 h; …

When (a) Append 'QA OAT-03 regenerate line: plan unchanged.' to the encounter dictation, put both models into failure (the S11 seam), tap Generate Note & Finish again. (b) Fail today's first Generate the same way, then open Post-Round

Then (a) An explicit failure; the dictation, including the appended line, is kept; the stored note still equals N1, or the app says plainly that N1 was replaced. (b) Post-Round does not show yesterday's note under today's heading: it is labelled as the previous note or carries its date

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：(a) Encounter checkpoint mustContain the appended line and 'couldn’t be generated'; Post-Round shows N1. Backend: rounding:get / snf:get note equals N1 exactly; if it does not, the failure copy must say N1 was replaced (recorded for Q3). (b) Post-Round shows the marker sentence only together with 'previous note' or yesterday's date in the same view; …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S29 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S29

A failure on a chart that already has a note: today's note survives a failed Regenerate, and yesterday's note never shows as today's (both contexts)

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status blocked → 卡住（卡住）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: partly）：Scripted probe: leg 1 LIVE Generate N1 on a Hospital chart and an NH chart; leg 2 (a) append a line, generateNote failed at the socket, Regenerate: explicit failure, appended line kept + stored, stored note == N1, Post-Round still shows N1; (b) charts seeded with yesterday's note (Hospital previousNotes, NH note 20 h old), today's first Generate fails: yesterday's marker must not sit under today's note heading, today's note field not holding it, kept as previous. — Failure injected at the client socket (shared backend has no fault seam); all outcomes in the oracle are UI / stored-row checks and are judged.

Detail:

Built (N1 generated live, then failed Regenerate / first Generate via the socket; stored note == N1, appended line kept, yesterday's marker never under today's heading). Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13; dev only). The spec is built and skips itself; run it with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1 once Quinn OKs local Generate.

证据：附了 0 个；没附 1 个：

  • web/qa-agent-tests/probes/oat03-generate-faults.spec.ts — 在本地跑测目录外，不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack: the both-models-fail seam of S11 (fault-ai) is switched on between leg 1 and leg 2, which nothing on dev may do (no env change, no action mock; runner-contract §10).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
